title: Bob's special bit is preserved by mixing
statement: Let $\omega_X$ and $\omega_Y$ be two samples of the hard distribution, and form the mixed sample that takes Alice's input from $\omega_X$ and Bob's input from $\omega_Y$. Then Bob's bit at the special coordinate of the mixed sample equals Bob's bit at the special coordinate of $\omega_Y$.
hypotheses_covered: two hard-distribution samples ωX and ωY
the mixed sample of ωX and ωY
replaced: The mixed sample has Bob's special bit from the second sample.
